description: This is a PHP source file defining the Address model class within the Opencart.Catalog.Model.Account namespace. It contains methods for managing customer address data, including adding, editing, deleting, and retrieving addresses.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: This class manages customer address data, providing methods to add, update, delete, and retrieve addresses from the database.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a specified customer and returns the new address ID.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Updates an existing address for a specific customer.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Deletes an address belonging to a customer, optionally by address ID.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific address for a customer.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses associated with a customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses for a customer.
